tools.description: List every skill in the agentlocker hub with name, description, owner, provenance and content hash. Use hub_search_skills first for a short list; call this to see every skill, then load one with hub_get_item (kind 'skill') only when its description matches the task. An entry with an 'error' field could not be fully read.
tools.name: hub_list_skills

tools.description: List the hub's rule fragments (shared policy and project instructions) with name, owner, provenance and content hash. Read the applicable ones, including 'shared-policy', with hub_get_item (kind 'rule') before starting work.
tools.name: hub_list_rules

tools.description: List nonsecret MCP server definitions indexed in the hub: transport, command and args or URL, and env or header names with secret:// references. Secret values are never returned and listing never starts a server. Use it to see which upstream servers exist and which credentials they need.
tools.name: hub_list_mcp_servers

tools.description: List routine definitions (repeatable agent jobs) with id, description, owner and provenance. Routines are recorded definitions only: they are disabled and this endpoint never runs them. Read one with hub_get_item (kind 'routine').
tools.name: hub_list_routines

tools.description: List nonsecret plugin metadata records imported into the hub (an empty list when none were imported). Read-only: nothing is installed or executed.
tools.name: hub_list_plugins

tools.description: List nonsecret connection metadata records (provider and endpoint of a linked service) imported into the hub, with secret:// references only. Read-only: nothing is contacted.
tools.name: hub_list_connections

tools.description: Find skills by describing the task in a few words. Returns the best three matches (same fields as hub_list_skills), 'searched' (skills considered) and 'remaining' (further matches not shown). An empty 'results' list means no skill matched well enough, not that the catalog is unavailable: fall back to hub_list_skills. Load a match with hub_get_item (kind 'skill') only when its description fits the task.

query.description: The task in a few plain words, such as 'monitor pull request CI'.

tools.name: hub_search_skills

tools.description: Load one skill, rule or routine by name after finding it with hub_search_skills or the matching hub_list_* tool. For a skill, 'files' maps every relative path (SKILL.md plus references/, scripts/ and assets/) to its UTF-8 text. Files that are not text, symlinks and anything past the 1 MiB text cap are named in 'omitted' with their size and reason, and 'truncated' is true when the cap cut content. Fetch individual ordinary files within 1 MiB with resources/read. A rule is one file; a routine is its routine.json plus its prompt file. The indexed sha256 is verified before anything is returned.

name.description: Entry name exactly as returned by the matching hub_list_* tool (a routine's id).

tools.name: hub_get_item
